title: Cafe Disco
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael creates a 'Cafe Disco' in the office basement as a fun hangout spot to boost employee morale. Meanwhile, Pam and Jim reveal they are getting married today in Ohio to avoid a waiting period. The Cafe Disco becomes a lively place but also causes some conflict when Phyllis injures her back while dancing, leading Michael to shut it down temporarily. Throughout the episode, various characters interact with the Cafe Disco concept in different ways, including Angela's resistance and Dwight's unique treatment of Phyllis's injury.

main_threads.thread: Michael creates the Cafe Disco as a place for employees to relax and have fun, encouraging participation with espresso and music, but it leads to unexpected consequences including Phyllis's injury and a temporary shutdown.
